name: getComponentStaticScope
description: Returns the static scope of a component — the variables shared by all instances of that CFC (variables declared with static in the component body). Accepts an instance of the component, a component template (the result of createObject), or a component name. Returns an empty struct when no static scope is available.

params.name: component
params.description: A component instance, a component template, or a dot-separated component name.

examples.title: Read the static scope
examples.description: Get the static variables of a component by name.
